SELECT DISTINCT
    apr.Party_Identifier AS Agent_Identifier,
    p.Policy_Identifier,
    p.Policy_Number,
    c.Claim_Identifier,
    c.Company_Claim_Number,
    cat.Catastrophe_Identifier,
    cat.Catastrophe_Name,
    cat.Catastrophe_Type_Code
FROM Agreement_Party_Role apr
JOIN Policy p
    ON p.Policy_Identifier = apr.Agreement_Identifier
JOIN Policy_Coverage_Detail pcd
    ON pcd.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
JOIN Claim_Coverage cc
    ON cc.Effective_Date = pcd.Effective_Date
   AND cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
JOIN Claim c
    ON c.Claim_Identifier = cc.Claim_Identifier
JOIN Catastrophe cat
    ON cat.Catastrophe_Identifier = c.Catastrophe_Identifier
WHERE apr.Party_Role_Code = 'AG'
ORDER BY Agent_Identifier, p.Policy_Identifier, c.Claim_Identifier;

SELECT
    c.Company_Claim_Number,
    SUM(CASE WHEN lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END) AS Loss_Payment_Amount,
    SUM(CASE WHEN lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END) AS Loss_Reserve_Amount,
    SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) AS Total_Loss_Amount
FROM Claim c
JOIN Claim_Amount ca
    ON c.Claim_Identifier = ca.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Loss_Payment lp
    ON ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier = lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Loss_Reserve lr
    ON ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier = lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier
WHERE lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL
   OR lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY c.Company_Claim_Number
ORDER BY c.Company_Claim_Number;

answer.sql:
WITH claim_amounts AS (
    SELECT
        ca.Claim_Identifier,
        SUM(CASE WHEN lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END) AS Loss_Payment_Amount,
        SUM(CASE WHEN lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END) AS Loss_Reserve_Amount,
        SUM(CASE WHEN ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END) AS Expense_Payment_Amount,
        SUM(CASE WHEN er.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END) AS Expense_Reserve_Amount
    FROM Claim_Amount ca
    LEFT JOIN Loss_Payment lp ON ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier = lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    LEFT JOIN Loss_Reserve lr ON ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier = lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    LEFT JOIN Expense_Payment ep ON ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    LEFT JOIN Expense_Reserve er ON ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier = er.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    GROUP BY ca.Claim_Identifier
),
claim_policy AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        cc.Claim_Identifier,
        pcd.Policy_Identifier
    FROM Claim_Coverage cc
    JOIN Policy_Coverage_Detail pcd
        ON cc.Effective_Date = pcd.Effective_Date
       AND cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
),
policy_premium AS (
    SELECT
        pa.Policy_Identifier,
        SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS Premium_Amount
    FROM Policy_Amount pa
    JOIN Premium pr ON pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pr.Policy_Amount_Identifier
    GROUP BY pa.Policy_Identifier
),
policy_holder AS (
    SELECT
        Agreement_Identifier,
        STRING_AGG(DISTINCT CAST(Party_Identifier AS VARCHAR), ', ') AS Policy_Holder_Party_Identifier
    FROM Agreement_Party_Role
    WHERE Party_Role_Code = 'PH'
    GROUP BY Agreement_Identifier
),
policy_agent AS (
    SELECT
        Agreement_Identifier,
        STRING_AGG(DISTINCT CAST(Party_Identifier AS VARCHAR), ', ') AS Agent_Party_Identifier
    FROM Agreement_Party_Role
    WHERE Party_Role_Code = 'AG'
    GROUP BY Agreement_Identifier
)
SELECT
    c.Company_Claim_Number,
    p.Policy_Number,
    ph.Policy_Holder_Party_Identifier,
    ag.Agent_Party_Identifier,
    pp.Premium_Amount,
    COALESCE(cam.Loss_Payment_Amount, 0) AS Loss_Payment_Amount,
    COALESCE(cam.Loss_Reserve_Amount, 0) AS Loss_Reserve_Amount,
    COALESCE(cam.Expense_Payment_Amount, 0) AS Expense_Payment_Amount,
    COALESCE(cam.Expense_Reserve_Amount, 0) AS Expense_Reserve_Amount
FROM Claim c
LEFT JOIN claim_amounts cam ON c.Claim_Identifier = cam.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN claim_policy cp ON c.Claim_Identifier = cp.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Policy p ON cp.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
LEFT JOIN policy_premium pp ON p.Policy_Identifier = pp.Policy_Identifier
LEFT JOIN policy_holder ph ON p.Policy_Identifier = ph.Agreement_Identifier
LEFT JOIN policy_agent ag ON p.Policy_Identifier = ag.Agreement_Identifier
ORDER BY c.Company_Claim_Number, p.Policy_Number;

SELECT p.Policy_Number, apr.Party_Identifier AS Agent_Id
FROM Policy p
JOIN Agreement_Party_Role apr ON p.Policy_Identifier = apr.Agreement_Identifier
WHERE apr.Party_Role_Code = 'AG'
ORDER BY p.Policy_Number, apr.Party_Identifier;

SELECT
    p.Policy_Number,
    AVG(date_diff('day', c.Claim_Open_Date, c.Claim_Close_Date)) AS avg_days_to_settle
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT cc.Claim_Identifier, pcd.Policy_Identifier
    FROM Claim_Coverage cc
    JOIN Policy_Coverage_Detail pcd
      ON cc.Effective_Date = pcd.Effective_Date
     AND cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
) cp
JOIN Claim c ON c.Claim_Identifier = cp.Claim_Identifier
JOIN Policy p ON p.Policy_Identifier = cp.Policy_Identifier
WHERE c.Claim_Open_Date IS NOT NULL
  AND c.Claim_Close_Date IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY p.Policy_Number
ORDER BY p.Policy_Number;

SELECT
    c.Company_Claim_Number,
    SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) AS Total_Loss
FROM Claim c
JOIN Claim_Amount ca
    ON ca.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Loss_Payment lp
    ON lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Loss_Reserve lr
    ON lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Expense_Payment ep
    ON ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Expense_Reserve er
    ON er.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
WHERE lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL
   OR lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL
   OR ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL
   OR er.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY c.Company_Claim_Number
ORDER BY c.Company_Claim_Number;

SELECT DISTINCT
    p.Policy_Number,
    c.Company_Claim_Number
FROM Policy p
JOIN Policy_Coverage_Detail pcd
    ON p.Policy_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Identifier
JOIN Claim_Coverage cc
    ON pcd.Effective_Date = cc.Effective_Date
   AND pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
JOIN Claim c
    ON cc.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
ORDER BY p.Policy_Number, c.Company_Claim_Number;

SELECT apr.Party_Identifier AS Agent_Id,
       COUNT(DISTINCT p.Policy_Identifier) AS Policy_Count
FROM Agreement_Party_Role apr
JOIN Policy p ON p.Policy_Identifier = apr.Agreement_Identifier
WHERE apr.Party_Role_Code = 'AG'
GROUP BY apr.Party_Identifier
ORDER BY Policy_Count DESC;

WITH claim_loss AS (
    SELECT
        ca.Claim_Identifier,
        SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) AS loss_amount
    FROM Claim_Amount ca
    WHERE ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier IN (
        SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM Loss_Payment
        UNION
        SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM Loss_Reserve
        UNION
        SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM Expense_Payment
        UNION
        SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM Expense_Reserve
    )
    GROUP BY ca.Claim_Identifier
),
claim_policy AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        cc.Claim_Identifier,
        p.Policy_Number
    FROM Claim_Coverage cc
    JOIN Policy_Coverage_Detail pcd
        ON cc.Effective_Date = pcd.Effective_Date
       AND cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
    JOIN Policy p
        ON pcd.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
)
SELECT
    cp.Policy_Number,
    AVG(cl.loss_amount) AS average_loss
FROM claim_policy cp
JOIN claim_loss cl
    ON cp.Claim_Identifier = cl.Claim_Identifier
GROUP BY cp.Policy_Number
ORDER BY cp.Policy_Number;

FROM Policy p

JOIN Premium pr ON pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pr.Policy_Amount_Identifier

SELECT
    p.Policy_Identifier,
    p.Policy_Number,
    apr.Party_Identifier AS Policy_Holder_Identifier
FROM Policy p
JOIN Agreement_Party_Role apr
    ON apr.Agreement_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
WHERE apr.Party_Role_Code = 'PH'
ORDER BY p.Policy_Identifier;

WITH claim_totals AS (
    SELECT
        ca.Claim_Identifier,
        SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) AS Total_Loss
    FROM Claim_Amount ca
    WHERE ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier IN (
        SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM Loss_Payment
        UNION
        SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM Loss_Reserve
        UNION
        SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM Expense_Payment
        UNION
        SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM Expense_Reserve
    )
    GROUP BY ca.Claim_Identifier
),
claim_policy AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        cc.Claim_Identifier,
        p.Policy_Number
    FROM Claim_Coverage cc
    JOIN Policy_Coverage_Detail pcd
        ON cc.Effective_Date = pcd.Effective_Date
       AND cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
    JOIN Policy p
        ON pcd.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
)
SELECT
    c.Company_Claim_Number,
    cat.Catastrophe_Name,
    cp.Policy_Number,
    ct.Total_Loss
FROM Claim c
JOIN claim_totals ct
    ON c.Claim_Identifier = ct.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Catastrophe cat
    ON c.Catastrophe_Identifier = cat.Catastrophe_Identifier
LEFT JOIN claim_policy cp
    ON c.Claim_Identifier = cp.Claim_Identifier
ORDER BY c.Company_Claim_Number, cat.Catastrophe_Name, cp.Policy_Number;

SELECT
    apr.Party_Identifier,
    SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS Total_Premium_Paid
FROM Premium pr
JOIN Policy_Amount pa
    ON pr.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier
JOIN Policy p
    ON pa.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
JOIN Agreement_Party_Role apr
    ON p.Policy_Identifier = apr.Agreement_Identifier
WHERE apr.Party_Role_Code = 'PH'
GROUP BY apr.Party_Identifier
ORDER BY Total_Premium_Paid DESC;

WITH claim_policy AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        cc.Claim_Identifier,
        p.Policy_Number
    FROM Claim_Coverage cc
    JOIN Policy_Coverage_Detail pcd
        ON cc.Effective_Date = pcd.Effective_Date
       AND cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
    JOIN Policy p
        ON pcd.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
),
claim_losses AS (
    SELECT
        ca.Claim_Identifier,
        SUM(CASE WHEN lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END) AS Loss_Payment_Amount,
        SUM(CASE WHEN lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END) AS Loss_Reserve_Amount,
        SUM(CASE WHEN ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END) AS Expense_Payment_Amount,
        SUM(CASE WHEN er.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END) AS Expense_Reserve_Amount
    FROM Claim_Amount ca
    LEFT JOIN Loss_Payment lp ON ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier = lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    LEFT JOIN Loss_Reserve lr ON ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier = lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    LEFT JOIN Expense_Payment ep ON ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    LEFT JOIN Expense_Reserve er ON ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier = er.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    GROUP BY ca.Claim_Identifier
)
SELECT
    cat.Catastrophe_Name,
    cp.Policy_Number,
    SUM(COALESCE(cl.Loss_Payment_Amount, 0)) AS Loss_Payment_Amount,
    SUM(COALESCE(cl.Loss_Reserve_Amount, 0)) AS Loss_Reserve_Amount,
    SUM(COALESCE(cl.Expense_Payment_Amount, 0)) AS Expense_Payment_Amount,
    SUM(COALESCE(cl.Expense_Reserve_Amount, 0)) AS Expense_Reserve_Amount,
    SUM(COALESCE(cl.Loss_Payment_Amount, 0)
      + COALESCE(cl.Loss_Reserve_Amount, 0)
      + COALESCE(cl.Expense_Payment_Amount, 0)
      + COALESCE(cl.Expense_Reserve_Amount, 0)) AS Total_Loss
FROM Claim c
JOIN Catastrophe cat
    ON c.Catastrophe_Identifier = cat.Catastrophe_Identifier
JOIN claim_policy cp
    ON c.Claim_Identifier = cp.Claim_Identifier
JOIN claim_losses cl
    ON c.Claim_Identifier = cl.Claim_Identifier
GROUP BY cat.Catastrophe_Name, cp.Policy_Number
ORDER BY cat.Catastrophe_Name, cp.Policy_Number;

SELECT p.Policy_Number, SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS Total_Premium
FROM Policy p
JOIN Policy_Amount pa ON pa.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
JOIN Premium pr ON pr.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier
GROUP BY p.Policy_Number
ORDER BY p.Policy_Number;

WITH claim_policy AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT cc.Claim_Identifier, pcd.Policy_Identifier
    FROM Claim_Coverage cc
    JOIN Policy_Coverage_Detail pcd
      ON cc.Effective_Date = pcd.Effective_Date
     AND cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
),
losses AS (
    SELECT cp.Policy_Identifier, SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) AS Total_Loss
    FROM claim_policy cp
    JOIN Claim_Amount ca ON ca.Claim_Identifier = cp.Claim_Identifier
    WHERE ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier IN (SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM Loss_Payment)
       OR ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier IN (SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM Loss_Reserve)
    GROUP BY cp.Policy_Identifier
),
premiums AS (
    SELECT pa.Policy_Identifier, SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS Total_Premium
    FROM Policy_Amount pa
    JOIN Premium pr ON pr.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier
    GROUP BY pa.Policy_Identifier
),
agents AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT Agreement_Identifier AS Policy_Identifier, Party_Identifier AS Agent_Id
    FROM Agreement_Party_Role
    WHERE Party_Role_Code = 'AG'
)
SELECT
    p.Policy_Number,
    a.Agent_Id,
    COALESCE(l.Total_Loss, 0) / NULLIF(pr.Total_Premium, 0) AS Loss_Ratio
FROM Policy p
JOIN agents a ON a.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
LEFT JOIN premiums pr ON pr.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
LEFT JOIN losses l ON l.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
ORDER BY p.Policy_Number, a.Agent_Id;

SELECT DISTINCT
    apr.Party_Identifier AS Policy_Holder_Identifier,
    p.Policy_Identifier,
    p.Policy_Number,
    c.Claim_Identifier,
    c.Company_Claim_Number,
    c.Claim_Description,
    cat.Catastrophe_Identifier,
    cat.Catastrophe_Name,
    cat.Catastrophe_Type_Code
FROM Claim c
JOIN Claim_Coverage cc
    ON c.Claim_Identifier = cc.Claim_Identifier
JOIN Policy_Coverage_Detail pcd
    ON cc.Effective_Date = pcd.Effective_Date
   AND cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
JOIN Policy p
    ON pcd.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
JOIN Agreement_Party_Role apr
    ON p.Policy_Identifier = apr.Agreement_Identifier
   AND apr.Party_Role_Code = 'PH'
LEFT JOIN Catastrophe cat
    ON c.Catastrophe_Identifier = cat.Catastrophe_Identifier
ORDER BY Policy_Holder_Identifier, c.Claim_Identifier;

SELECT

    COALESCE(ca.Loss_Reserve_Amount, 0) AS Loss_Reserve_Amount,
    COALESCE(ca.Expense_Payment_Amount, 0) AS Expense_Payment_Amount,
    COALESCE(ca.Expense_Reserve_Amount, 0) AS Expense_Reserve_Amount,
    p.Policy_Number,
    ph.Policy_Holder_Party_Identifier,
    COALESCE(pp.Premium_Amount, 0) AS Premium_Amount,

LEFT JOIN policy_premium pp ON p.Policy_Identifier = pp.Policy_Identifier
LEFT JOIN policy_holder ph ON p.Policy_Identifier = ph.Agreement_Identifier

       COUNT(DISTINCT p.Policy_Identifier) AS Policy_Count

WHERE apr.Party_Role_Code = 'PH'
GROUP BY apr.Party_Identifier
ORDER BY apr.Party_Identifier;

SELECT p.Policy_Number, COUNT(DISTINCT c.Claim_Identifier) AS Claim_Count
FROM Claim c
JOIN Claim_Coverage cc ON c.Claim_Identifier = cc.Claim_Identifier
JOIN Policy_Coverage_Detail pcd ON cc.Effective_Date = pcd.Effective_Date AND cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
JOIN Policy p ON pcd.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
GROUP BY p.Policy_Number
ORDER BY Claim_Count DESC

WITH claim_policy AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        p.Policy_Number,
        cc.Claim_Identifier
    FROM Policy p
    JOIN Policy_Coverage_Detail pcd
        ON pcd.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
    JOIN Claim_Coverage cc
        ON cc.Effective_Date = pcd.Effective_Date
       AND cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
),
loss_amounts AS (
    SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM Loss_Payment
    UNION
    SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM Loss_Reserve
    UNION
    SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM Expense_Payment
    UNION
    SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM Expense_Reserve
),
claim_loss AS (
    SELECT
        ca.Claim_Identifier,
        SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) AS Total_Loss
    FROM Claim_Amount ca
    JOIN loss_amounts la
        ON la.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    GROUP BY ca.Claim_Identifier
)
SELECT
    cp.Policy_Number,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cp.Claim_Identifier) AS Number_Of_Claims,
    SUM(COALESCE(cl.Total_Loss, 0)) / COUNT(DISTINCT cp.Claim_Identifier) AS Average_Loss
FROM claim_policy cp
LEFT JOIN claim_loss cl
    ON cl.Claim_Identifier = cp.Claim_Identifier
GROUP BY cp.Policy_Number
ORDER BY cp.Policy_Number;

SELECT p.Policy_Number, SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS Total_Premium
FROM Premium pr
JOIN Policy_Amount pa ON pr.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier
JOIN Policy p ON pa.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
GROUP BY p.Policy_Number
ORDER BY p.Policy_Number;
